summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a change in the company's Nasdaq trading symbol from AGH to PUSA effective May 18, 2026, and disclosing that the change is made in anticipation of a previously announced proposed business combination with Autonomous Power Corporation (Powerus). No deal terms, pricing, or board recommendation are provided; the filing is a routine update about a ticker change. The business combination itself is not the subject of this filing. The filing has no special-situation event; it is purely disclosure of a symbol change.
